newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares stagnate ahead of new budget.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares stagnate ahead of new budget.

text.p: Norwegian shares shuffled in a thin three point range to end unmoved on Friday as a lack of impulses and investor cautiousness ahead of next week's 1997 budget proposal stalled activity.
Dealers said without the influence of outside impulses the market would continue to tread water.
Oslo's Total share index ended 0.01 percent up at 845.26 points. It was the highest closing level this week and 2.67 points higher from the close last Friday.
Turnover at 588 million crowns was 20 percent off from Thursday's volume.
Forestry group Norske Skog extended the week's losses, closing 2.50 crowns down at 185 crowns in light volume.

The company has fallen almost five percent since September 19 due to pressure on paper markets. Skog reduced newsprint prices by five percent from September 1 due to remain in line with European moves.
